subject: Evotech access governance sprint plan & sequencing
messages:
From: Alex Torres <atorres@evotech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evotech: SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist requirements for Redwood onboarding

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get Redwood running in our staging environment. I pulled together our access requirements so we can align on sequencing: attached Evotech_SSO_requirements.pdf. High level: 

- SSO: SAML 2.0 (IdP: Okta). We need IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, and a mapped attribute set (email, firstName, lastName, groups).
- SCIM: full user/provisioning sync. We will want group-to-role mapping: e.g., SF-Eng -> Developer role, SRE -> Admin role.
- IP allowlist: staging CIDR blocks will be 10.32.0.0/20 and 52.34.11.0/24 (we can provide final list).
- Service accounts: dedicated service account for pipeline access (name convention prefixed with redwood-evotech-).
- Org policies: retention limits, data export controls for staging datasets.

Immediate asks from our side to unblock scheduling:
1) A short mutual action plan (timeline + owners).
2) A sample SCIM schema you expect and any limits (bulk-sync cadence, rate limits).
3) Expected firewall egress IPs and any packet inspection requirements.

Can we aim for a sequencing call early next week to lock the mutual action plan and target a staging cutover two weeks after signoff?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Platform Engineering, Evotech
atorres@evotech.com

Attachment: Evotech_SSO_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@evotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evotech: SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist requirements for Redwood onboarding

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list and the attachment. Forwarding the ask to our CS and Security leads and putting an initial sequencing proposal below.

On Sun, Aug 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alex Torres <atorres@evotech.com> wrote:
> Hi Mina / Marissa,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday...

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Discovery + schema alignment (this week): SCIM attribute mapping, group->role table, and Okta assertions. Owner: Evotech (IdP) + Redwood (CS).
2) Staging setup (3 days): configure SP metadata in Okta, create service account, and apply staging IP allowlist. Owner: Evotech DevOps + Redwood Infra.
3) SCIM dry-run (2 days): one-way push for a single team, validate mappings and role assignments. Owner: Redwood integrations.
4) Cutover & smoke tests (1 day): enable full provisioning, run authentication smoke tests, exercise the RBAC matrix.
5) Post-cutover review & rollback window (2 days): verify audit logs, retention settings, and backup plan.

Questions for Evotech (please reply inline):
- Can you share a SCIM sample JSON for a developer user and for a group? (DevOps will need to test mapping.)
- Confirm whether Okta will sign assertions with SHA-256 (we default to SHA-256 on our side).
- Finalize staging IPs by EOD Tuesday so we can schedule the staging window.

I'll add Marissa and Ben (security) to this thread to capture the MAP and any policy exceptions.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@evotech.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Evotech: SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist requirements for Redwood onboarding

Alex / Mina — attaching a Mutual Action Plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_001.xlsx) and a small CSV service-account template to capture naming and permissions. Summary of what's in the MAP:

- Week 0 (alignment): share SCIM sample + Okta metadata, confirm assertion digest, and collect staging CIDRs.
- Week 1 (staging): apply SP metadata to Okta, create a redwood-evotech-staging service account, and apply IP allowlist in our staging gateway.
- Week 2 (SCIM dry-run + tests): provision 20 users from Dev team alpha group, validate group->role mapping and audit log entries.
- Cutover week: roll to limited production slice, run canary queries, monitor latency and error rates.

Two practical notes:
- Service account naming: use prefix redwood-evotech-{env}-{purpose} and include an owner_email field in the CSV.
- SCIM rate limit: our hosted SCIM accepts 200 requests/minute; for bulk you can do batched requests in chunks of 100.

Action items for Evotech this week: share SCIM sample JSON, export Okta SP metadata file, and confirm the staging CIDR list. Once we have those, I can lock calendar slots with our Infra engineer and run a 45-minute staging cutover.

Thanks — attaching: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_001.xlsx (Excel), service-account-template.csv (CSV).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@evotech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Evotech: SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist requirements for Redwood onboarding

Alex — quick security notes from our side before we lock the MAP: 

- Fine with Okta SAML (SHA-256). Please include the fingerprint for the signing cert in the SP metadata.
- For SCIM: we'll run provisioning in incremental mode first; we log all SCIM events to an audit stream for 90 days (extendable on enterprise contracts).
- IP allowlist: our staging gateway accepts CIDR lists; please provide final list by Tue 2026-08-24. For prod, we recommend a minimum of /24 per region to avoid accidental blocks.
- Service account policy: we require unique owner_email and a 90-day rotation reminder. Marissa, can we add rotation scheduling to the MAP?

Also, can Evotech share the SOC2 Auditor contact or a link to their current SOC2 Type II report if you're comfortable? We need evidence for our fourth-party risk intake. If that's not possible, a SOC2 bridge letter or a security whitepaper will do for initial onboarding.

If Evotech can confirm the SCIM samples and the staging CIDRs this week, CS + Infra can run the dry-run next Wednesday.

Ben Carter
Director, Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
